Command and coordination in flood management
se: The next meeting is on Thursday 26 November 2026 at 13.30 hrs in Room CA 427, floor 4, Parliament House (also held online), according to the meeting notice. The agenda is a study of the problems and obstacles in the command system and in joining up flood disaster management under the Water Resources Act B.E. 2561 and the Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Act B.E. 2550, with the Office of the National Water Resources, the Hydro-Informatics Institute, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation and the Royal Irrigation Department invited. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.
it: Study of the problems and obstacles in the command system and in joining up flood disaster management under the Water Resources Act B.E. 2561 and the Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Act B.E. 2550

te: Low birth rate: hearing from education agencies
se: Meeting on Tuesday 24 November 2026 at 13.30 hrs, Meeting Room 405, floor 4, Parliament House. The agenda is to consider ways to respond to the low birth rate and to support healthy births and growth. The Office of the Basic Education Commission and the Equitable Education Fund are invited, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.
it: Ways to respond to the low birth rate and to support healthy births and growth
